landing.heroDescription: Bona amahugurwa meza y'umwuga yagenewe abaganga b'amatungo n'abandi bakora mu mwuga w'ubuvuzi bw'amatungo mu Rwanda. Wige ku bigisha b'inararibonye, wongere ubumenyi n'ubushobozi kandi ukurikirane ubumenyi bushya mu buvuzi bw'amatungo.
landing.heroImageAlt: Abakozi b'ubuvuzi bw'amatungo bakorana n'amatungo mu Rwanda
landing.imageCaption: Kubaka abahanga bakomeye mu buvuzi bw'amatungo mu Rwanda
landing.whyTitle: Kwiga k'umwuga bigamije guteza imbere ubuvuzi bw'amatungo
landing.whyDescription: Ongera ubumenyi n'ubushobozi byawe mu mwuga ukoresheje amasomo ateguwe by'umwihariko ku bakora mu buvuzi bw'amatungo.
landing.featureCoursesDescription: Bona amasomo ateguwe neza ku bijyanye n'ubuvuzi bw'amatungo, ubuzima bw'amatungo n'imikorere y'umwuga.
landing.featureInstructorsDescription: Wige ku baganga b'amatungo babifitiye ubumenyi n'abigisha bafite ubunararibonye bwo mu kazi.
landing.featureCertificationDescription: Soza amasomo yawe, ukore ibizamini kandi werekane ubumenyi bwawe ubone icyemezo cy'umwuga.
landing.ctaTitle: Witeguye guteza imbere umwuga wawe w'ubuvuzi bw'amatungo?
landing.ctaDescription: Reba amasomo yacu maze utangire kwiga uyu munsi hamwe na RCVD E-Learning.
